review_policy: Retain time/identity review and absent optional dates; no automatic approval
empty_query_handling: Only observed explicit empty-list DOM; add EMPTY_QUERY_NOT_HISTORICAL_COVERAGE review, never certify no historical events
ticker_errors: Quarantine known layout/profile/article errors, typed timeouts and plain HTTP 404/410/500/502/503/504; preserve evidence and proceed to next ticker; no automatic retry on resume
source_stops: 401/403/429/challenge, Retry-After, SSL/DNS/unknown transport errors, integrity/configuration/IO errors stop the run; budgets/interrupt remain resumable
resume: New output, same C8/source/code contract; skip quarantined tickers, never automatically retry source access boundary
coverage: One group and title candidates; no full historical/revision certification
